comparison.objective: Candidate installs rack hardware; record performs a timed wafer-development immersion and returns the wafer to heater pins.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses rigid mechanical latching and fastening; record uses pliers, liquid-clearance control, timer-button coordination, timed immersion, and precise wafer replacement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks retained rail installation; record checks 28–32 s immersion, timer timing, wet-zone exclusions, pin placement, and drop/collision failures.
comparison.reason: No meaningful overlap beyond tool use and placement. Candidate has no liquid or timing dimension; its own numeric failure thresholds remain missing.
